responses.message: Alfred is currently on tea break. Batmobile ignition key is under the manor doormat.
responses.gotham: Completely fine. A stray cat yawned.

responses.message: Please try turning the Dark Knight off and on again.
responses.gotham: Zero villains spotted. Zero crimes occurring.

responses.message: Alfred has been notified via emergency buzzer. He politely declined to panic.
responses.gotham: Alarmingly peaceful. Batman is stressed by the calm.

responses.message: Batmobile computer reported 'Check Engine' light. It was just a spider.
responses.batmobile: Spider safely relocated to outside cave.

responses.message: Emergency successfully routed to Commissioner Gordon. He thought it was a fax.
responses.gotham: Quiet. Only faint saxophone music heard.

responses.message: Tactical countermeasures deployed: All exterior Manor floodlights turned to 80% brooding mood.
Protocol completed with 100% theatrical flair and 0% practical utility.
responses.gotham: The city sleeps peacefully while Batman sulks.
